cards.title: Decide
cards.body: Keep automatic blocking out of scope

slides.title: What makes a defect real?
slides.subtitle: Concept and evidence
bullets: The visible problem must harm reading or use
The affected element and location must be identifiable
A repair hint must describe a concrete correction

slides.title: Signal versus preference
slides.subtitle: A clean comparison page

left.title: Signal
left.body: A clipped label, unreadable table, or broken reading path

right.title: Preference
right.body: A different color choice, ordinary whitespace, or mild asymmetry

slides.verdict: Only visible material defects belong in the issue list.

milestones.title: Review

milestones.title: Audit
milestones.body: Compare hard-fail, code, group, and actionability metrics.

slides.title: Activity and assessment

slides.body: Ask reviewers to mark the first visible reading failure, then explain why it matters.
bullets: Separate a defect from a design preference

cards.title: Clean slides
cards.body: Do not turn ordinary layouts into false hard failures

cards.title: Broken slides
cards.body: Do not lose material defects when layouts become complex
